fusions.name: Torpor Imposed
fusions.desc: A strike with the rod that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Frostbite] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Stare
fusions.desc: A cone 4.5 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun on the Throne
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Prerogative
fusions.desc: By day, your damage rises by 10%.
